summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which detects whether the Bun runtime is available on the installer's machine and, if not, downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the bundled math_init.js shipped inside the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) containing a shuffled string array of ~1000+ entries and a rotator function, and setup.mjs itself uses `_0x`-style hex-renamed identifiers and string-map indirection consistent with an obfuscator.io transform. The file name math_init has no correspondence to any Storybook configuration feature, and a Storybook config package has no functional need to fetch a separate JavaScript runtime at install time and execute an obfuscated 727KB module under it. The effect is that `npm install` of this package auto-executes obfuscated attacker-authored code on the installer's host through an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
